_comment: Prisma texts. To add a language, copy this file with its code (fr.json, de.json…) and translate the values; keep the keys.

plugin.error.animation_unsupported: This deck doesn't support that animation
plugin.error.gif_too_big: The GIF is too big (8 MB max)
plugin.error.icon_too_big: The icon is too big (8 MB max)
plugin.error.profile_delete_active: It's the active profile: switch to another one before deleting it
plugin.error.profile_delete_default: «Default» can't be deleted: OpenDeck needs it
plugin.error.profile_inside_itself: A profile can't go inside itself or its subprofiles
plugin.error.profile_name_chars: The name can't contain / \ : * ? " < > | or start or end with a dot
plugin.error.profile_name_long: The name is too long (40 characters max)

plugin.error.profiles_folder: OpenDeck's profiles folder can't be found

pi.t_hundredths: Show hundredths (may be slow on the MSD-ONE)
pi.volver_a_buscar_programas: Look again for programs playing sound
pi.escribe_el_nombre_del: Type the executable's name or pick it. It works even if it isn't playing now: when it plays, the action controls it.
pi.mostrar_el_titulo_en: Show the title on the key
pi.en_el_msd_one: On the MSD-ONE there's no GIF and anything that moves runs at half the frames: the deck handles few changes per second.
pi.manda_la_orden_al: Sends the command to the player; the title comes from its window's name (YouTube, Spotify, VLC).
pi.gira_para_cambiar_el: Turn to change the volume; press the dial or tap the screen to mute. Double-click to change the audio output (speakers, headphones…): turn to switch between them and press to finish.
pi.el_elegido_con_la: The one chosen with the dial
pi.pulsar_cambia_a_ese: Press: switches to that profile and, if it has subprofiles, the dial moves through them. Hold (over half a second): goes up a level without switching profile.
pi.los_subperfiles_el_orden: Subprofiles, order and icons are set in the Prisma panel, «Profiles» tab.
pi.ensena_el_perfil_elegido: Shows the profile chosen with the profile dial, with its level above («root» or its parent profile). It says «● active» when it is already the profile in use.
pi.es_solo_para_ver: It is only for display: pressing it does nothing.
pi.deslizar_el_dedo_por: Swiping left or right on the screen is like turning the dial.
pi.si_el_doble_no: If the double does nothing, the click or tap acts at once; otherwise they wait a moment in case the second one comes.
pi.el_icono_de_cada: Each profile's icon and the active frame colour are set in the Prisma panel, «Profiles» tab.
pi.la_rueda_recorre_en: The dial goes through, in order, the «Switch Profile» keys in the row of virtual keys shown in the editor below the dials. Prisma adds any missing ones when OpenDeck starts and when you create a profile from the panel.
pi.gira_para_elegir_el: Turn to pick a profile on the same level; what pressing does is set below.
pi.gira_y_al_parar: Turn and, when you stop for a moment, it switches to that profile.
pi.solo_las_horas_y: «Hours only» and «Minutes only» let you build a column clock with the MSD-ONE side keys: hours on top, minutes in the middle and the date below.
pi.ensena_el_dia_de: Shows the weekday, the day and the month. Pressing it does nothing.
pi.vacio_la_ciudad_del: Empty: the city of the day/night schedule in Prisma's panel.
pi.con_varias_vistas_girar: With several views, turning the dial slides from one to the next. «Next view» also works when pressing.
pi.con_varias_vistas_siguiente: With several views, «Next view» on press goes from one to the next. «Today», «Tomorrow» and «Day after tomorrow» let you build a column forecast with the MSD-ONE side keys.
pi.datos_de_open_meteo: Data from Open-Meteo (free, no account), every 15 minutes. Pollen is only available in Europe and in season; pollen levels are approximate.
pi.busca_localidad: Type your town and pick it from the list.
pi.credito_fuentes: Air quality and pollen: Copernicus (CAMS). Places: GeoNames.
pi.t_rounds: Focus rounds before the long break
pi.t_auto: Start the next phase by itself
pi.t_edit: Change the time with the dial
pi.t_note_key: Set the time here. To change it with a dial, put it on an MSD-PRO dial.
pi.t_note_dial: «Change»: the time blinks and the dial changes it; the faster you turn, the bigger the steps (10 s, 30 s, 1 min, 5 min). Press or leave the dial still to finish.
pi.t_end_note: When it ends, the key blinks; pressing it stops that. It keeps counting even if you switch profiles.
pi.sw_note_off: Tapping this dial’s zone responds right away.
pi.sw_note_on: Tap this dial’s zone, release and swipe at a normal speed. If the gesture isn’t detected well, adjust the swipe time in the Prisma panel (Screen tab).

panel.prfDeleteAskKids: Delete the profile “{name}”? It has {kids} inside: you can move them up one level or delete everything.
panel.prfEditNote: The name also changes in OpenDeck, and its Switch Profile keys, subprofiles, links and icon follow it. If you change the name, the deck reconnects for a moment.
panel.prfDefaultNote: “Default” can’t be renamed (OpenDeck needs it); only its icon.
panel.prfRenaming: Renaming… (the deck reconnects for a moment in OpenDeck)
panel.swallow: The press that wakes it does not trigger the action
panel.briNote: While the day/night schedule is on, it controls brightness.
panel.schedOff: Off: the Screen brightness is used.
panel.animNote: The shutdown animation plays when OpenDeck closes. When the PC shuts down there may not be time. Save to use them on startup and shutdown.
panel.reverse: Reverse (bottom to top, right to left)
panel.lnkHint: Each row is a link: when any of these decks switches to one of those profiles, the others switch to the one in their column. «— no change —» leaves that deck as it is. «+ Deck» adds a column; ✕ removes it and its links. OpenDeck profiles are not touched.
panel.lnkEmpty: Add at least two decks to link their profiles
panel.lnkNote: It does not matter how you switch: with the profile knob, from OpenDeck or with a «Switch Profile» key. Each deck in the table gets virtual keys with a «Switch Profile» per profile; missing ones are added the next time OpenDeck starts.
panel.prfTitle: Profiles of this deck (the one selected on the left)
panel.prfBorder: Frame of the active profile on the knob
panel.prfNone: This deck has no profiles in OpenDeck
panel.prfNote: The icon is optional and only used by the Prisma profile knob: it is stored in the Prisma folder and nothing changes in OpenDeck. Without an icon, the knob shows that profile's «Switch Profile» key. PNG, JPG, SVG or GIF (a GIF moves on the knob).
panel.prfNoWheel: This deck has no knobs, so there is no frame to choose: its icons are kept for when they are used elsewhere.
panel.prfSubTip: Create a subprofile inside this one
panel.prfDrag: Drag: on the edge of another profile it goes above or below; on its centre, it goes inside as a subprofile
panel.prfCreating: Creating the profile… (the deck reconnects for a moment in OpenDeck)
panel.prfNewNote: It is created in OpenDeck right away, with its «Switch Profile» on the virtual keys of every profile. The deck blinks for a moment in OpenDeck while it rereads the profiles.
panel.calNote: Show the test image: it appears only on the selected zone and the rest goes black. Move the controls while looking at the deck until all 7 rings and the 4 white corner squares are visible, equally thick on every side. Save to apply it to all your icons.
panel.oneNote: This deck only has step animations. To keep it smooth at most 4 keys change at a time: if a step needs more (for example with a trail), it is split into several sends.
panel.name: Name
panel.empty: No deck is connected. Plug it in and open the settings again.
panel.polar: No sunrise or sunset today at that latitude
panel.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
panel.bgNoImage: Choose an image or use a solid color
panel.bgNote: It is stored in the deck itself and takes a few seconds. If you do not see it, unplug the deck and plug it back in. Use the orientation fix only if it shows rotated or mirrored.
panel.cityHint: Type your town and pick it from the list.
panel.prfDeleting: Deleting the profile… (the deck reconnects for a moment in OpenDeck)
panel.swipeWindow: Time to swipe after a tap (touch screen)

opendeck.Name: Prisma
opendeck.Description: Prisma, one plugin to rule them all: Mars Gaming MSD-ONE (AKP153 family) and MSD-PRO (AKP05 / N4 family) decks, and their Mirabox and Ajazz clones.

com.malzar.prisma.audio.playpause.Name: Play / Pause
com.malzar.prisma.audio.playpause.Tooltip: Plays or pauses whatever is playing (Spotify, browser, VLC…)

com.malzar.prisma.audio.volup.Name: Volume up
com.malzar.prisma.audio.volup.Tooltip: Raises the master volume or a program's volume

com.malzar.prisma.audio.voldown.Name: Volume down
com.malzar.prisma.audio.voldown.Tooltip: Lowers the master volume or a program's volume

com.malzar.prisma.audio.mute.Name: Mute
com.malzar.prisma.audio.mute.Tooltip: Mutes or unmutes the master volume or a program

com.malzar.prisma.audio.dial.Name: Volume (dial)
com.malzar.prisma.audio.dial.Tooltip: Turn to change the master volume or a program's volume; press to mute

com.malzar.prisma.profiles.Name: Profiles (dial)
com.malzar.prisma.profiles.Tooltip: Turn to go through the profiles on the same level (wrapping around); press to switch

com.malzar.prisma.profilego.Name: Open / switch profile
com.malzar.prisma.profilego.Tooltip: Switches to the profile chosen with the dial (or a fixed one) and opens its subprofiles; hold to go up a level

com.malzar.prisma.profilenow.Name: Current profile
com.malzar.prisma.profilenow.Tooltip: Shows the profile chosen with the dial and whether it is active. Pressing does nothing

com.malzar.prisma.w.clock.Name: Clock
com.malzar.prisma.w.clock.Tooltip: The time: digital or analogue; on a dial, with the date

com.malzar.prisma.w.date.Name: Date
com.malzar.prisma.w.date.Tooltip: The weekday, the day and the month

com.malzar.prisma.w.weather.Name: Weather
com.malzar.prisma.w.weather.Tooltip: Current weather and forecast (Open-Meteo). With several views, the dial moves between them

com.malzar.prisma.t.timer.Name: Timer
com.malzar.prisma.t.timer.Tooltip: Countdown with the time you set; on a dial, turn to change the time

com.malzar.prisma.t.pomodoro.Name: Pomodoro
com.malzar.prisma.t.pomodoro.Tooltip: Focus and breaks (25 + 5 by default), with a long break every few rounds
